items.summary: 【Anthropic与SpaceX创纪录IPO背后：承销行抱怨交易流程复杂】金十数据11月22日讯，SpaceX和Anthropic今年先后完成创纪录IPO，承销行均获得超过5亿美元费用，但参与交易的部分银行家私下抱怨流程复杂、限制严苛，与以往IPO截然不同。据知情人士透露，SpaceX由马斯克团队全程主导上市流程，严格控制信息披露、股票推介对象及配售规模，部分银行甚至在不清楚承销报酬的情况下签约。Anthropic则要求部分承销银行将交易团队限制在4名资深银行家以内，并要求部分银行高管签署竞业限制协议，禁止核心交易团队成员在公司上市后六个月内为OpenAI、Cursor、DeepSeek和HuggingFace等竞争对手提供服务。此外，公司通过NetRoadshow平台分享文件，追踪银行家访问记录，以防止信息泄露，但也增加了承销团队的工作难度。

items.title: Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing stock exchanges: Lower financing margin ratio to support modestly higher leverage, free up financing capacity and boost liquidity
items.summary: Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing stock exchanges said lowering the financing margin ratio under statutory countercyclical adjustment measures should support a modest increase in leverage, free up financing capacity and boost liquidity, as margin financing activity has recently weakened and overall leverage remains low. For outstanding financing contracts, brokerages may calculate investors’ available margin balances under the revised rules, putting existing funds to greater use. Brokerages must tighten oversight of margin trading by investors with abnormal trading activity, apply stricter risk-control parameters and prudently manage credit limits and trading fees. In serious cases, they may restrict, suspend or terminate margin trading services or deny contract extensions.

items.summary: 【沪深北交易所：适当降低融资保证金比例，有助于适度提高杠杆比例、释放融资空间、提升市场流动性】金十数据11月22日讯，沪深北交易所调整融资保证金比例。近期，融资交易活跃度明显下降，整体杠杆水平不高，根据法定的逆周期调节安排，适当降低融资保证金比例，有助于适度提高杠杆比例、释放融资空间、提升市场流动性，促进市场长期稳定健康发展。对于本次调整前尚未了结的融资合约，证券公司可以按照修改后的规定计算投资者的保证金可用余额，进一步盘活存量资金。此外，本次通知要求证券公司加强投资者融资融券交易行为管理，对存在异常交易行为的投资者从严适用保证金比例、可充抵保证金证券折算率等风险控制指标，审慎把控授信额度、交易费率等，情节严重的，必要时可依法采取限制、暂停或终止向其提供融资融券交易服务、不予展期等措施。前述要求旨在防范部分投资者利用两融工具过度投机和异常交易，有利于维护市场交易秩序，助力市场健康稳定运行，切实保护投资者合法权益。

items.title: China lowers minimum margin-financing ratio to 80%, potentially unlocking 400 bln yuan
items.summary: China’s Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing stock exchanges cut the minimum margin-financing ratio to 80% from 100%, effective Nov. 22, raising maximum leverage to 1.25 times. Analysts estimate the change could generate nearly 100 bln yuan in new funds, with brokerages also able to apply the lower ratio to outstanding margin-financing contracts, potentially freeing another 300 bln yuan. The total potential increase in available funds is nearly 400 bln yuan, based on an outstanding margin-financing balance of about 2.2 tln yuan.

items.summary: The Shenzhen Stock Exchange is seeking public comment on rules governing market-making in ChiNext stocks. Securities firms approved by the CSRC to conduct market-making in listed securities may apply to the exchange by filing to provide the service. items.summary: 1. 美国总统特朗普在社交平台发布一张图片，称民主党导致股市受损。 2. 承诺与民主党合作，将信用卡利率上限设为10% ——据福克斯新闻，美国总统特朗普表示，将与即将上任的民主党国会合作，推动设定信用卡利率上限，以兑现其2024年竞选期间作出的承诺。特朗普说：“我愿意这么做。这些信用卡公司已经赚了很多钱。”民主党和特朗普均支持限制信用卡利率，目前主流提案是将上限设为10%，而纽约联储8月调查显示，美国信用卡利率中位数约为22.2%。 3. 称FBI数据库遭黑客入侵或有“积极一面”：可能借机发现选举舞弊信息 ——美国总统特朗普周六表示，联邦调查局（FBI）一套存储执法信息的计算机系统遭黑客入侵，但事件或许也有“积极一面”，可能借此发现选举舞弊等信息。据知情人士透露，黑客侵入的是美国国家犯罪信息中心（NCIC），该数据库存有FBI指纹记录、通缉人员、暴力犯罪者及失踪人员等信息，仅供执法部门使用，但不属于机密系统，目前尚不清楚哪些数据遭窃取。 4. 称寻求与伊朗达成一项永久性协议 ——美国总统特朗普在美国福克斯新闻频道21日播出的采访节目中说，将寻求与伊朗达成一项永久性协议。特朗普说：“我所做的是，我要确保即使四年、十五年或二十年后我们有一位不称职的总统，我达成的协议也将是永久性的。我不会让某人允许他们拥有核武器并对达成的协议出尔反尔。”特朗普还称，没有考虑伊朗政权更迭，“我从来不太在乎政权”。

items.title: CITIC Securities: U.S.-listed AI stocks may face valuation pressure early in 2027, recover midyear and diverge late in the year
items.summary: CITIC Securities expects the AI supply chain to face valuation pressure early in 2027, recover midyear and diverge late in the year. From now through Q1 2027, tighter data-center regulation and concerns over a mismatch between cloud service providers’ capital spending and operating cash flow may weigh on valuations and increase financing pressure on emerging cloud providers. In Q2-Q3, clearer Texas regulations and restrictions milder than expected could ease the policy risk premium, with upstream hardware stocks leading a valuation recovery; industry consolidation may also strengthen leading companies’ competitive positions. In Q4, rising demands for returns on AI commercialization investment, alongside a potential 2028 funding gap and private-credit refinancing pressures, may prompt a repricing of credit risk and drive capital toward companies with more predictable earnings.

items.title: South Korea to prepare stock-market stabilization fund, ease buyback limits and crack down on illegal short selling
items.summary: South Korea’s Ministry of Economy and Finance said on Nov. 22 that the government will strengthen the activation mechanism for its stock-market stabilization fund so it can be deployed at any time as market conditions warrant. From Nov. 24, listed companies will face a relaxed daily limit on treasury-share purchase orders for three months, encouraging buybacks to cushion market declines. The Financial Supervisory Service and Korea Exchange will conduct intensive monitoring for illegal short selling over the same period and punish violations. Authorities will also monitor margin trading, unsettled trades and forced liquidations to contain the risk of cascading selling.

items.title: Suzhou industrial output by designated-size firms rises 7.3% in Jan-Oct
items.summary: Suzhou's industrial output at designated-size firms rose 7.3% year on year to 4.30548 tln yuan in Jan-Oct 2026, while industrial value added increased 9.2%. October value added growth accelerated to 9.6% from 8.8% in September. Electronics and information technology output rose 10.7% to 1.33265 tln yuan, and equipment manufacturing output gained 8.7% to 1.43774 tln yuan; together, the sectors contributed 82.8% of total industrial output growth. High-tech manufacturing output increased 12.5%, accounting for 63.8% of the growth. Jan-Sep profits at designated-size industrial firms rose 13.6% year on year.

items.title: High fuel costs have squeezed U.S. flights; shutdown risk returns at year-end
items.summary: U.S. government funding expires Dec. 11. Trump is seeking several hundred billion dollars in additional defense spending, citing the Iran war, but funding sources and spending priorities remain disputed, CNN reported. Congressional leaders favor another stopgap, though talks are expected to stall until after the Dec. 1 Senate Democratic leadership election. Without a budget or funding extension by Dec. 11, a shutdown would begin Dec. 12. High fuel costs have already led airlines to cut less-profitable routes, while bookings at major carriers remain strong. A shutdown that leaves TSA screening and air traffic control understaffed could make delays and cancellations harder to manage amid packed schedules and winter storms, aviation analyst Zach Griff said. Disruptions would depend on whether funding is extended, staffing levels and weather.

items.summary: 伊朗巴斯基组织副主席库雷希表示，过去，军事评估主要依据2000公里范围内的威胁，但如今，随着最高领袖一项审慎指示得到落实，相关军事格局已经发生变化。如果过去的重点是射程，那么现在的重点就是“精度”，目标精度已达到厘米级乃至毫米级。美国人过去认为伊朗的导弹是用PS合成的，甚至认为只是“热水器”。因此，他们认为自己即使身处1000公里或2000公里之外也很安全。但随着最高领袖提出的武器厘米级精度要求得到落实，这些距离内的任何目标都将不再安全。武器精度的这一变化意味着，即使只对装备进行小幅调整，也能将导弹射程提升数倍，并精准击中任何指定目标的正中心。

items.title: U.S. October PCE inf seen rising to 3.8%, lifting December Fed hike bets
items.summary: U.S. consumers are expected to maintain strong spending ahead of the holiday shopping season, with inflation pressure yet to curb outlays. Economists surveyed by Bloomberg see inflation-adjusted PCE rising 0.1% MoM in October, after strong gains in each of the prior two quarters. The PCE price index is forecast to rise 3.8% YoY, while core PCE is also expected to accelerate, bolstering expectations for a December Fed rate hike. Continued job growth and resilient consumer and business activity give policymakers room to focus on inflation, even as rising prices add to pressure on the Fed.
